verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents connecting your own AI providers through custom endpoints in librechat.yaml, including OpenRouter, Ollama, and OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible services, which covers the bring-your-own-backend half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows token-usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation. missing for 10: token usage display, cost tracking per model or conversation, explicit per-user API key entry documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: Add custom AI providers like OpenRouter, Ollama, and Anthropic-compatible gateways to LibreChat using librechat.yaml
LibreChat supports OpenAI API-compatible services as custom endpoints.
